programme.desc: A new bride is left under the care of friends when her husband travels to Transylvania for a meeting with Count Orlok. Plagued by horrific visions and an increasing sense of dread, she soon encounters an evil force that's far beyond her control.

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: When a new Ghostface killer emerges in the quiet town where Sidney Prescott has built a new life, her darkest fears are realised as her daughter becomes the next target.

programme.title: Rabbit Trap
programme.desc: While collecting audio samples, a musician creates a field recording of a mysterious sound never before heard by human ears. As the echoes of music bleed into the surrounding countryside, ancient and malevolent woodland forces are disturbed.

programme.title: Presence
programme.desc: A family becomes convinced they are not alone after moving into their new home in the suburbs.

programme.title: The Shining
programme.desc: Frustrated writer Jack Torrance takes a job as the winter caretaker at the ominous, mountain-locked Overlook Hotel so that he can write in peace. When he arrives there with his wife and son, they learn that the previous caretaker had gone mad. Slowly Jack becomes possessed by the evil, demonic presence in the hotel. Based on the book by Stephen King.

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their Mississippi hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

programme.title: Insidious: The Last Key
programme.desc: Parapsychologist Elise Rainier and her team travel to Five Keys, N.M., to investigate a claim of a haunting in her childhood home. She must soon confront and destroy her greatest fear -- the demon that she accidentally set free years earlier.

programme.title: The Conjuring: Last Rites
programme.desc: In 1986 paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren travel to Pennsylvania to vanquish a demon from a family's home.

programme.title: Batman Forever
programme.desc: DA Harvey Dent and vengeful scientist The Riddler plan to take down Batman, as Dent wrongly believes that it is Batman's fault he was disfigured, and the scientist is angry with Bruce Wayne for rejecting his experiments. The Gotham City superhero is going to need his new partner, boy wonder Robin, but will he be able to cope with the distraction of sexy doctor Chase Meridian?

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: Doug Quaid has an ordinary life, although he dreams nightly of Mars - a planet he has never visited. Determined to find the meaning of these dreams, he visits Rekall Inc - a specialist in memory implants - intent on buying a memory trip to Mars, but the implant brings to the surface long-lost clues as to Quaid's true identity.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Filmmaker Terri Flores is travelling deep in the Amazon jungle looking for a forgotten tribe. Terri and her crew, which includes an anthropologist and a cameraman, come across Paul, who is stranded on the riverbank. He offers to help them find the tribe, but his secretive behaviour puts everyone on edge. They realise too late that he's using them to find a legendary anaconda that's worth a fortune, if they can catch it.

programme.title: Army of Darkness
programme.desc: Ash is transported back to medieval days, where he is captured by the dreaded Lord Arthur. Aided by the deadly chainsaw that has become his only friend, Ash is sent on a perilous mission to recover the Book of the Dead, a powerful tome that gives its owner the power to summon an army of ghouls.

programme.title: Batman Returns
programme.desc: After Selina Kyle sees more than she should in her boss's office, she has an 'accident', falling from the top floor of the building to the street below. Awoken by the licking of cats, she is surprised to find herself still very much alive. She vows to take revenge on her boss and becomes a female avenger, defending women under attack and providing assistance to Batman's efforts to keep the streets of Gotham safe.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: Detective Nick Curran is charged with finding out the truth after Catherine Tramell, a sensual bisexual writer, is suspected of murdering her lover with an ice pick, exactly the method used in one of her books. Unfortunately, he becomes too closely involved.

programme.title: Sudden Death
programme.desc: Thriller set at the Stanley Cup ice hockey finals. It's Game 7 and the winner will lift the trophy but with the Vice President attending, a criminal has his eyes on a bigger prize. Holding the VP hostage, his demands are backed up by the shooting of selected hostages and the threat of bombs planted around the stadium. However, a rink security guard, whose kids are in the crowd, refuses to be cowed.

programme.title: Jackie Chan's First Strike
programme.desc: A Hong Kong detective is contracted to recover a stolen nuclear warhead. Hired by both the CIA and Russian intelligence, the kung-fu cop is harassed, assaulted and framed for murder as he delves into the murky world of international arms dealing.

programme.title: Robin Hood: Men in Tights
programme.desc: Something strange is afoot in Sherwood Forest when Robin Hood and his very merry men poke fun at all things green and scarlet in this parody. Robin and his gang have to fight evil Prince John while King Richard is off on a crusade.

programme.title: Roxanne
programme.desc: Update of the 'Cyrano de Bergerac' story about a long-nosed fire chief who falls in love with a beautiful astronomer. The chief is too ashamed of his appearance to make advances himself but is drawn into assisting his rival, a dull but handsome visiting fireman, from behind the scenes as his chances of love are hampered by his lack of confidence.

Vowing revenge, Bourne sets out to prove his innocence and bring the culprits to justice, but he has to evade CIA head Pamela Landry, who is convinced he is guilty.

programme.desc: It's Erin Burnett's turn to step out front and try to maintain a viable viewer presence for CNN in the weekday news arena. But the former CNBC anchor won't worry about ratings for her hourlong general news program, comparing that burden to "death." Instead, she'll concern herself with translating world events into relevant information for viewers, paying close attention to such topics as the Middle East and women's issues. "I want people to say that our show is smart. I want our show to be authentic", Burnett says in a promo. "I want our show to have courage". Left unsaid, of course, is that she wants her show to have a big audience, too.

programme.desc: After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

programme.title: BBC Weekend News
programme.desc: The latest national and international news from the BBC.

programme.title: Weather for the Week Ahead
programme.desc: Detailed weather forecast.

programme.title: Songs of Praise
programme.desc: On All Saints' Day, Pam Rhodes celebrates the life of St Francis of Assisi 800 years since his death and meets Christians still inspired by his teachings.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: Kate Robbins presents this month's Lifeline appeal on behalf of PMRGCAuk, a charity providing support, information and advocacy for people affected by polymyalgia rheumatica and giant cell arteritis.

programme.title: Wallace & Gromit in The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
programme.desc: Story of the chase for a giant rabbit terrorising a town's allotments and vegetable patches days before the annual vegetable-growing competition. As Wallace and his trusty companion are called into action with their pest control business, a dastardly Lord Victor Quartermaine competes to capture the Were-Rabbit and win the heart of a beautiful lady.

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: Celebrating the highlights from the series, from the intense heat of the tropics to the planet's frozen poles, through to its unexplored depths. New worlds and extraordinary never-before-seen animal behaviours are revealed.

programme.title: Secrets of the Aquarium
programme.desc: Catching rays is a challenge with a sting in the tail. Xav has to find a way to keep Friday the turtle out of trouble. Plus, Freyja gives some care home residents a moving close encounter with sharks.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team visit Ipswich. Among the items brought to light are a collection of pre-historic spearheads, an early American flag, a silver tankard and a pair of spectacles worn by Napoleon. There's also the latest in the quest to find the UK's champion collector, including a man with 5,000 Dinky toys.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin is in the Suffolk countryside at Glemham Hall, which dates back to the Tudor era. Antiques expert David Fletcher discovers some scripts from the television series 'Lovejoy', and Jonathan Pratt spots some Beatles bobbing head dolls.

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Les Dennis, Jenny Eclair, Owain Wyn Evans and Lauren Patel test their general knowledge skills on this week's House of Games.

programme.title: Strictly Come Dancing: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor is on hand with more Strictly exclusives ahead of the weekend's Halloween extravaganza. Also, this week's all-star panel discuss the couples' next dances as they take to the ballroom floor for the first time this week.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Featuring extensive coverage of the day's top national and international news stories, along with explanations about the context and potential aftereffects.

programme.title: BBC Weather
programme.desc: The latest weather forecast.

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Dougie visits Scotland's first inclusive farm where agriculture is accessible for all. Arlene finds out how the people of Jura are finding new outlets for venison.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As the growing season draws to a close, it's time to catch up with Adam Frost in his new garden. In the Peak District, Rekha Mistry offers up some more timely advice on how to grow veg in pots.

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Past with Janina Ramirez
programme.desc: Dr Janina Ramirez turns detective and heads to Egypt to uncover the real story of how Howard Carter unearthed a pharaoh's tomb when everyone else believed there were no more great Egyptian finds to be made. She discovers that some of Tutankhamun's treasures are missing and reveals the name of the person responsible. She delves into the origins of the supposed pharaoh's curse, and finds the truth about the king's brutal injuries.

programme.title: Carrie
programme.desc: Carrie White is a shy young girl who doesn't make friends easily. After her classmates taunt her about her horrified reaction to her totally unexpected first period, one of them takes pity on her and gets Tommy Ross, her boyfriend and class hunk to invite Carrie to the senior prom. Meanwhile, another girl who has been banned from the prom for her continued aggressive behaviour is not as forgiving. Based on the book by Stephen King.

programme.title: The Ones Below
programme.desc: After giving birth to her first child, a woman starts to believe that her downstairs neighbours have sinister intentions.

programme.title: Blue Lights
programme.desc: Sandra enlists help to expose Gerry's secrets, while Tommy and Shane inch closer to exposing the drug pipeline.

programme.title: Not Going Out
programme.desc: Caught stealing an undiscovered Banksy, Lee claims to be the artist to escape a security guard. His lie backfires when he becomes the target of a blackmail scheme.

programme.title: This Is BBC TWO
programme.desc: A preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: Flutter is sent to the 'naughty berg' as punishment when he falls foul of an old Piri rule. But when the others start telling tales, he's not the only one to be banished.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: Whilst Dad searches for a faulty wire, Cosima and Big Lizard play tag in the ship and accidentally break Big Lizard's bath bed! Where will he sleep now? And where's that pesky wire?

programme.title: Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy loses a ball near a scary scarecrow. Is he brave enough to get it back?

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: The heroes quest on Spookyween to stop whatever is menacing the pumpkin patch and find that a headless skeleton is using pumpkins as a head.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a magic hat that can transform them to match their costumes.

programme.title: Duck and Frog
programme.desc: Duck and Frog are excited when they get a job as movie extras, but they end up destroying every take, irritating the director, who has a very short fuse.

programme.title: Bro's in Control
programme.desc: Can Joe and Adam scare 'Traitors' stars Freddie Fraser and Jessie Roux?

programme.title: Gladiators: Epic Pranks
programme.desc: Nitro goes undercover for a special Children in Need prank on Apollo and recruits Sabre, Alfie Watts, and Pudsey to help.

programme.title: Stage Stars
programme.desc: With Halloween approaching, the Year 7s have been told about the school ghost and set off to hunt for it. Meanwhile, the Anything Goes cast try not to get too spooked by the thought of opening night for their show.

programme.title: Newsround
programme.desc: News magazine keeping young viewers up to date with the latest stories and events happening at home and abroad.

programme.title: Blue Peter
programme.desc: This week the presenters are getting ready for Halloween with a spooky banquet, and they're joined in studio by a gruesome special effects makeup artist!

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: Steve Backshall recalls his journey into The Cave of the Hanging Serpents.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As the growing season draws to a close, it's time to catch up with Adam Frost in his new garden. In the Peak District, Rekha Mistry offers up some more timely advice on how to grow veg in pots.

programme.title: Odette
programme.desc: The true story of one of the Allies' most courageous spies, Odette Churchill, who was captured by the Gestapo and subjected to torture in an attempt to make her betray her companions.

programme.title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden
programme.desc: Marcus steps things up with a hunt for the perfect cow. He heads to Shropshire in search of a rare breed that has been around in England for centuries, the English Longhorn. A close encounter with a bull isn't enough to put him off.

programme.title: Nadiya's Everyday Baking
programme.desc: With the assistance of her daughter Maryam, Nadiya shares family bakes that are as fuss-free as they are delicious. First up, Nadiya and Maryam, a self-confessed 'flapjack fanatic', share their ultimate recipe for this classic family favourite.

programme.title: Sense and Sensibility
programme.desc: Two sisters face romantic complications in the financially and socially motivated milieu of late 18th-century England.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: The public are encouraged to take a risk and sell their antiques at an auction, with no guarantees as to how much they could be earning.

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: Four famous faces paired with a friend or a loved one must tackle the most formidable race yet - traversing the ancient jungles and indigenous heartlands of Borneo to the southern tip of Australia.

programme.title: Battle of Britain
programme.desc: Air Chief Marshal Sir Hugh Dowding is the man who has to marshal a depleted British fighter force against incessant Luftwaffe attacks in the summer of 1940. While he's fighting for more planes to combat the German aerial invasion, pilots such as Squadron Leaders Skipper and Harvey have to take the strain of daily combat, constantly staring death in the face.

programme.title: Live: Serie A Football
programme.desc: Live coverage of AC Milan v Inter Milan in the Italian Serie A.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Relive some of the biggest hits of 1996 with these Top of the Pops classic performances. Summer hits were aplenty with Peter Andre, Gina G and Los Del Rio all bringing sunshine to Elstree.

programme.title: Oasis: Live at the City of Manchester Stadium
programme.desc: Following the release of their sixth studio album, Oasis return to their hometown of Manchester for a triumphant concert at the City of Manchester Stadium, in a multi-camera shoot directed by Dick Carruthers.

programme.title: Oasis: Right Here, Right Now
programme.desc: Oasis discuss their recent career, revisit their old neighbourhood in Manchester, and perform songs from their album, 'Be Here Now'.

programme.title: No Bears
programme.desc: Follow two parallel love stories in which the partners are thwarted by hidden, inevitable obstacles, the force of superstition, and the mechanics of power.

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: The Porthcawl crew's training night is disrupted when a call comes from a dog walker who has spotted a surfer in trouble below the cliffs at nearby Rest Bay. During the peak of a cyclone known as Storm Amy, Bridlington's lifeboat is tasked to a Dutch trawler that has lost power 13 miles off the Yorkshire coast. In Ireland, an urgent call comes in to the Crosshaven crew from a yacht taking part in a local race; on board, an elderly sailor is reported to have broken his leg.

programme.title: This City Is Ours
programme.desc: After discovering that the person responsible for Ricardo's death is someone close to him, Michael scrambles for a way to protect them from the consequences without jeopardising Diana.

programme.title: This Is BBC TWO
programme.desc: A preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Matt Baker, Anita Rani, Margherita Taylor, Joe Crowley and John Craven meet five remarkable young people whose lives have been transformed through support from BBC Children in Need-funded projects.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A comprehensive compilation of the latest and the most important news stories, updates and developments from the UK and different parts of the world.

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Dougie visits Scotland's first inclusive farm where agriculture is accessible for all. Arlene finds out how the people of Jura are finding new outlets for venison.

programme.title: Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek is island hopping in this round-up of his favourite Welsh island walks. He goes wild in west Wales as he sails to Skomer Island - a national nature reserve of international importance due to its seabirds - where he gets a close-up view of the puffins, razorbills and guillemots before staying up late to see the Manx shearwater. Next, Derek goes to Flat Holm Island where he braves a huge colony of seagulls and discovers more about the island's past, including some Victorian gun placements.

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: A look back at some of the best segments from 'Saturday Kitchen'. The popular cookery show offers recipes and ideas for mouth-watering food, interviews with great chefs and celebrity guests.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Eva finds herself in Alsace, a frontier land, sitting between Germany and France, with a cuisine to match.

programme.title: Best Bakes Ever
programme.desc: With Britain more obsessed with baking than ever, actress and cake expert Jane Asher brings together a selection of recipes from the nation's favourite television chefs, for 'Best Bakes Ever'.

programme.title: I Was Monty's Double
programme.desc: British officers Major Harvey and Colonel Logan plot to give the Germans misinformation about their military strategy. When Harvey spots an actor who looks like General Montgomery, he uses him to impersonate the general in North Africa.

programme.title: Live: WSL
programme.desc: Women's Super League action as Charlton Athletic face Chelsea.
